description: Defines the interface for a polar code class, including parameters, sets, and interleaver configurations for polar coding as per 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: polar_code
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for polar code operations, including parameter accessors and initialization.

methods.name: get_n
methods.description: Returns the base-2 logarithm of the codeword length.

methods.name: get_E
methods.description: Returns the codeword length after rate matching.

methods.name: get_nPC
methods.description: Returns the number of parity check bits.

methods.name: get_K_set
methods.description: Returns the set of message bit indices.

methods.name: get_PC_set
methods.description: Returns the set of parity-check bit indices.

methods.name: get_F_set
methods.description: Returns the set of frozen bit indices.

methods.name: get_blk_interleaver
methods.description: Returns the permutation for block interleaving.

methods.name: get_ibil
methods.description: Returns the internal bit interleaver state.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Initializes index sets and interleaver configuration based on message length, code length, and interleaver type.
